# 70th Drama Desk Awards

| venue = The Town Hall
}}
The 70th Drama Desk Awards winners are set to be announced on May 17, 2026, recognizing excellence in Broadway and Off-Broadway productions during the 2025–26 season. Nominations were announced on April 29, 2026, with Beau the Musical and Mexodus receiving the most nominations with 10 each. The most-nominated Broadway productions were Ragtime and The Balusters, with eight nominations each.
Winners and nominees
The 70th Drama Desk Award nominations were announced on Wednesday, April 29, 2026, by Raúl Esparza and Helen J. Shen. The winners are set to be announced on May 17, 2026 in an awards gala held at The Town Hall, hosted by Marla Mindelle.
